query:
SELECT c.account_state, a.realization_address,
                  EXISTS(
                      SELECT 1 FROM auth_account_deletions d
                      WHERE d.user_id = c.actor_id AND d.executed_at IS NOT NULL
                  ) AS "deleted!"
           FROM user_credentials c JOIN actors a ON a.id = c.actor_id
           WHERE c.actor_id = $1
